head: TikTok down on 24 November: feed, search and profiles stopped loading
dek: TikTok was down for many users on Tuesday afternoon, US time: For You videos, search results, favorites and profile pages didn't load in the iPhone and Android apps or on the web. It worked again by about 3:45 p.m. Eastern time.
details: Downdetector showed about 25,000 reports around 2:56 p.m. Eastern time. Links to single videos also failed for some people. A TikTok spokesperson told The Verge it was a brief technical issue that affected access to TikTok, that it was fixed, and apologized. TikTok didn't give a cause.
where: iPhone and Android apps and the website, Tuesday 24 November
means: If TikTok wouldn't load for you on Tuesday afternoon, the problem was on TikTok's side, not your phone or account.
todo: Nothing to do: the problem is fixed. If the app still acts up, close and reopen it.
thumb_words: TIKTOK WAS DOWN FOR AN HOUR
